description: Is a question about a given count stage answerable at a given time? Returns verdict ok / too-early / inside-window / too-late, settle_after, and the resolvable sources. Built to stop questions that read the provisional count when they mean the final one.

election.description: Election id, e.g. "brazil-general-2026"; list ids with upcoming_elections

race.description: Race id, e.g. "president"; optional when the election has one race

name: check_question

meta.description: What this answer was built from; cite dataset_version

ask_at.description: Time the question would be asked (ISO)

replaced_at.description: When a later stage replaces this one

figures_in_html.description: For a results page: whether its own HTML shows a count (false: figures load by script or the page only links on; null: not read)

kind.description: race_results, feed, results_index, emb_home, directory or media

kindReason.description: Why it was classified that way

oracle_reads.description: Settlement-oracle lab reads of this URL: right, wrong, unread, lab, at

resolvable.description: Can this page answer a results question?

secondary_source.description: Global Election Index's own page with the count we recorded: a secondary source when the authority's page cannot be read. Null until a count is recorded.

copied_from.description: The authority file or page the figures come from

stage.description: Count stage of the figures shown

settle_after.description: Earliest time the question can be settled

verdict.description: ok, too-early, inside-window, too-late or no-window

window.description: Expected window for one count stage

confidence.description: announced (law or authority), precedent (last election) or estimate

observedAt.description: When the authority actually published it; null until observed

replacedAt.description: When a later stage replaces it on the authority page

source.description: Source of a stage published outside the authority page

title: Check a question
